input.command: d=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kk-review-code-XXXXXX) && git diff --cached > "$d/staged.patch" && git show HEAD:config.py > "$d/base-config.py" && git show HEAD:tests/test_report.py > "$d/base-test_report.py" && git rev-parse HEAD && git hash-object config.py tests/test_report.py && echo "$d" && ls "$d"
input.description: Write staged diff and base blobs to temp evidence dir
